column2:
fade(v.)褪色、逐漸消失、凋謝
(無詞性變化)
fade away 逐漸消失
fade out 淡出
The colors of my old T-shirt have faded after many washes.
(我那件舊T恤洗了很多次後已經褪色了。)
As night came, the sound of the music slowly faded away.
(夜晚降臨時，音樂聲漸漸消失了。)

faint(adj./v./n.)微弱的、模糊的、昏倒、昏厥
faintly(adv.)微弱地、模糊地
faint light 微弱的光
faint from 因…而昏倒
She fainted from the heat during the school assembly.
(她在朝會時因為太熱而昏倒了。)
We could see a faint light at the end of the tunnel.
(我們可以看見隧道盡頭有一絲微弱的光線。)

fairly(adv.)相當地、公平地
fair(adj.)公平的
fairness(n.)公平
fairly easy 相當簡單
treat someone fairly 公平對待某人
The test was fairly easy, so most students passed.
(考試相當簡單，所以大部分學生都及格了。)
A good teacher treats every student fairly.
(好老師會公平對待每個學生。)

fairy(n./adj.)仙女、小精靈、仙女的
(無詞性變化)
fairy tale 童話故事
tooth fairy 牙仙子
My grandmother told me fairy tales before bed.
(我奶奶在睡前講童話故事給我聽。)
In the story, a fairy gave the girl three wishes.
(故事中，一位仙女給了女孩三個願望。)

faith(n.)信任、信心、信仰
faithful(adj.)忠實的、忠誠的
have faith in 對…有信心
lose faith 失去信心
I have faith in my teammates.
(我對我的隊友有信心。)
Don't lose faith in yourself after one failure.
(不要因為一次失敗就對自己失去信心。)

fake(adj./v./n.)假的、偽造、假裝、冒牌貨
(無詞性變化)
fake news 假新聞
fake smile 假笑
Be careful not to share fake news online.
(小心不要在網路上分享假新聞。)
He faked an illness to stay home from school.
(他裝病不去上學。)

familiar(adj.)熟悉的、常見的
familiarity(n.)熟悉
be familiar with 熟悉…
familiar face 熟悉的面孔
Are you familiar with this part of the city?
(你熟悉城市的這一區嗎？)
I saw a familiar face in the crowd.
(我在人群中看到一張熟悉的面孔。)

fancy(adj./n./v.)花俏的、高級的、想像、喜歡
(無詞性變化)
fancy restaurant 高級餐廳
fancy dress 化裝服
We had dinner at a fancy restaurant for Dad's birthday.
(我們在一間高級餐廳為爸爸慶生。)
Her dress is too fancy for a school party.
(她的洋裝對學校派對來說太花俏了。)

fare(n.)車費、票價
(無詞性變化)
bus fare 公車票價
taxi fare 計程車費
Students can get a discount on the bus fare.
(學生搭公車可以享有票價優惠。)
The taxi fare from the airport was quite high.
(從機場出發的計程車費相當貴。)

farther(adv./adj.)更遠地、更遠的
far(adj./adv.)遠的、遠地
farthest(adj./adv.)最遠的、最遠地
farther away 更遠處
walk farther 走得更遠
The station is farther than I thought.
(車站比我想的還要遠。)
We can't walk any farther; let's take a rest.
(我們走不動了，休息一下吧。)

fashionable(adj.)流行的、時髦的
fashion(n.)時尚、流行
fashionably(adv.)時髦地
fashionable clothes 時髦的服裝
become fashionable 開始流行
Wide-leg pants have become fashionable again.
(寬褲又重新流行起來了。)
She always wears fashionable clothes.
(她總是穿著時髦的衣服。)

faucet(n.)水龍頭
(無詞性變化)
turn on the faucet 打開水龍頭
leaky faucet 漏水的水龍頭
Please turn off the faucet while you brush your teeth.
(刷牙時請關掉水龍頭。)
Dad fixed the leaky faucet in the kitchen.
(爸爸修好了廚房漏水的水龍頭。)

fearful(adj.)害怕的、可怕的
fear(n./v.)恐懼、害怕
fearless(adj.)無畏的
fearful of 害怕…
fearful look 害怕的神情
The little boy was fearful of the dark.
(那個小男孩很怕黑。)
She gave me a fearful look when the lights went out.
(燈熄滅時她露出害怕的神情看著我。)

feather(n.)羽毛
(無詞性變化)
as light as a feather 輕如鴻毛
Birds of a feather flock together. 物以類聚。
This pillow is filled with soft feathers.
(這個枕頭裡填滿了柔軟的羽毛。)
The parrot has bright green feathers.
(那隻鸚鵡有鮮綠色的羽毛。)

fence(n.)籬笆、圍牆、柵欄
(無詞性變化)
build a fence 築圍籬
sit on the fence 保持中立、觀望
There is a white fence around the garden.
(花園四周有一圈白色的籬笆。)
The dog jumped over the fence and ran away.
(那隻狗跳過柵欄跑走了。)

fighter(n.)戰士、鬥士、戰鬥機
fight(v./n.)打架、戰鬥
fire fighter 消防員
fighter jet 戰鬥機
The fire fighters saved the family from the burning house.
(消防員從失火的房子裡救出了那一家人。)
She is a real fighter and never gives up.
(她是個真正的鬥士，從不放棄。)

firework(n.)煙火
(無詞性變化)
fireworks show 煙火表演
set off fireworks 放煙火
We watched the New Year's fireworks at Taipei 101.
(我們在台北101看跨年煙火。)
People set off fireworks to celebrate the festival.
(人們放煙火慶祝節日。)

fist(n./v.)拳頭、握拳
(無詞性變化)
make a fist 握拳
shake one's fist 揮舞拳頭
He made a fist and hit the table angrily.
(他握緊拳頭生氣地捶桌子。)
The baby held my finger in her tiny fist.
(那個寶寶用小小的拳頭握住我的手指。)

flame(n./v.)火焰、燃燒、發紅
flaming(adj.)燃燒的
in flames 著火、燃燒中
candle flame 燭火
The old building was in flames within minutes.
(那棟老舊建築在幾分鐘內就陷入火海。)
She blew out the candle flame.
(她吹熄了燭火。)

flash(n./v.)閃光、閃現、閃耀
flashy(adj.)浮華的、俗豔的
in a flash 瞬間
flash of lightning 一道閃電
A flash of lightning lit up the sky.
(一道閃電照亮了天空。)
The summer vacation went by in a flash.
(暑假一眨眼就過去了。)

flashlight(n.)手電筒
(無詞性變化)
turn on a flashlight 打開手電筒
shine a flashlight 用手電筒照
Keep a flashlight at home in case of a power outage.
(家裡要準備手電筒以防停電。)
He shined his flashlight into the dark cave.
(他用手電筒照進漆黑的山洞。)

flavor(n./v.)味道、口味、調味
flavorful(adj.)美味的、風味十足的
ice cream flavor 冰淇淋口味
add flavor 增添風味
What's your favorite ice cream flavor?
(你最喜歡哪種冰淇淋口味？)
Garlic adds a lot of flavor to the dish.
(大蒜為這道菜增添許多風味。)

flesh(n.)肉、果肉、肉體
fleshy(adj.)多肉的
flesh and blood 血肉之軀、親骨肉
in the flesh 本人、親自
The flesh of this mango is sweet and juicy.
(這顆芒果的果肉香甜多汁。)
I finally saw my favorite singer in the flesh.
(我終於見到我最喜歡的歌手本人了。)

float(v./n.)漂浮、浮起、浮板、遊行花車
floating(adj.)漂浮的
float on water 浮在水面上
float in the air 飄在空中
Leaves were floating on the surface of the pond.
(葉子漂浮在池塘水面上。)
The kids used floats to learn to swim.
(孩子們用浮板學游泳。)

flock(n./v.)(鳥、羊)群、成群結隊而行
(無詞性變化)
a flock of sheep 一群羊
flock to 湧向、蜂擁至
A flock of birds flew over the rice fields.
(一群鳥飛過稻田。)
Tourists flock to the night market every weekend.
(每到週末觀光客就湧向夜市。)

flood(n./v.)洪水、大量、淹沒、湧入
flooding(n.)淹水
heavy flood 大洪水
be flooded with 充滿、湧入大量的
The typhoon caused serious floods in the south.
(颱風在南部造成嚴重水災。)
The office was flooded with phone calls.
(辦公室湧進大量的電話。)

flour(n.)麵粉
(無詞性變化)
wheat flour 小麥麵粉
a bag of flour 一袋麵粉
Mix the flour with milk and eggs to make pancakes.
(把麵粉跟牛奶和蛋混合來做鬆餅。)
We need two cups of flour for this cake.
(做這個蛋糕需要兩杯麵粉。)

flute(n.)長笛
flutist(n.)長笛演奏者
play the flute 吹長笛
flute solo 長笛獨奏
My sister plays the flute in the school band.
(我妹妹在學校樂隊吹長笛。)
The flute solo in the concert was beautiful.
(音樂會中的長笛獨奏非常優美。)

foggy(adj.)有霧的、模糊的
fog(n.)霧
foggy morning 起霧的早晨
foggy weather 有霧的天氣
Drive slowly on foggy mornings.
(起霧的早晨要慢慢開車。)
It was so foggy that we couldn't see the mountain.
(霧大到我們看不到那座山。)

fold(v./n.)摺疊、對摺、摺痕
folder(n.)資料夾
fold clothes 摺衣服
fold one's arms 雙臂交叉
Please fold your clothes and put them away.
(請把你的衣服摺好收起來。)
He folded the paper into a plane.
(他把紙摺成一架飛機。)

follower(n.)追隨者、跟隨者、(社群)追蹤者
follow(v.)跟隨、遵循
have followers 擁有追蹤者
loyal follower 忠實追隨者
The singer has millions of followers on Instagram.
(那位歌手在 Instagram 上有數百萬追蹤者。)
He is a loyal follower of the team.
(他是這支球隊的忠實支持者。)

fond(adj.)喜歡的、喜愛的
fondness(n.)喜愛
be fond of 喜歡…
fond memories 美好的回憶
My grandfather is fond of gardening.
(我爺爺喜歡園藝。)
I have fond memories of my childhood.
(我對童年有美好的回憶。)

forever(adv.)永遠
(無詞性變化)
last forever 永遠持續
forever young 永遠年輕
Nothing lasts forever.
(沒有什麼是永遠不變的。)
I will remember this trip forever.
(我會永遠記得這趟旅行。)

fortune(n.)財富、運氣、命運
fortunate(adj.)幸運的
fortunately(adv.)幸運地
make a fortune 發大財
tell one's fortune 算命
He made a fortune by selling his app.
(他靠賣掉他的應用程式發了大財。)
The old woman offered to tell my fortune.
(那位老婦人說要幫我算命。)

fountain(n.)噴泉、泉源
(無詞性變化)
drinking fountain 飲水機
water fountain 噴水池、飲水機
The children played around the fountain in the park.
(孩子們在公園的噴水池旁玩耍。)
There is a drinking fountain near the gym.
(體育館附近有一台飲水機。)

frank(adj.)坦白的、直率的
frankly(adv.)坦白地
to be frank 坦白說
frank opinion 坦率的意見
To be frank, I don't like this plan.
(坦白說，我不喜歡這個計畫。)
Thank you for your frank opinion.
(謝謝你坦率的意見。)

freeze(v./n.)結冰、冷凍、僵住、凍結
freezing(adj.)極冷的
frozen(adj.)冷凍的、結冰的
freeze to death 凍死
frozen food 冷凍食品
Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
(水在攝氏零度時結冰。)
The cat froze when it saw the dog.
(那隻貓看到狗時僵住了。)

freezer(n.)冷凍庫、冰櫃
freeze(v.)冷凍
in the freezer 在冷凍庫裡
freezer bag 冷凍保鮮袋
Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
(把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。)
There is some frozen chicken in the freezer.
(冷凍庫裡有一些冷凍雞肉。)

frequent(adj./v.)頻繁的、常去(某地)
frequently(adv.)經常
frequency(n.)頻率
frequent visitor 常客
frequent flyer 飛行常客
He is a frequent visitor to the library.
(他是圖書館的常客。)
Earthquakes are frequent in Taiwan.
(台灣經常發生地震。)

fright(n.)驚嚇、恐懼
frighten(v.)使驚嚇
frightened(adj.)受驚的
in fright 驚恐地
stage fright 怯場
She screamed in fright when she saw the snake.
(她看到蛇時嚇得尖叫。)
Many students have stage fright before giving a speech.
(許多學生在演講前會怯場。)

frighten(v.)使驚嚇、使害怕
frightened(adj.)受驚的、害怕的
frightening(adj.)可怕的
frighten away 嚇跑
be frightened of 害怕…
The loud thunder frightened the little girl.
(轟隆的雷聲嚇壞了那個小女孩。)
Don't make noise, or you'll frighten the birds away.
(別出聲，不然你會把鳥嚇跑。)

fuel(n./v.)燃料、加燃料、助長
(無詞性變化)
fossil fuel 化石燃料
run out of fuel 燃料耗盡
Our car is running out of fuel.
(我們的車快沒油了。)
We should use less fossil fuel to protect the earth.
(我們應該少用化石燃料來保護地球。)

fund(n./v.)基金、資金、提供資金
funding(n.)資金、經費
raise funds 募款
school fund 學校基金
The students held a sale to raise funds for the trip.
(學生們舉辦義賣為旅行募款。)
The project is funded by the government.
(這個計畫由政府出資。)

fur(n.)毛皮、軟毛
furry(adj.)毛茸茸的
soft fur 柔軟的毛
fur coat 毛皮大衣
My cat has soft white fur.
(我的貓有柔軟的白色毛。)
Many people refuse to wear fur coats.
(許多人拒絕穿毛皮大衣。)

gallon(n.)加侖(容量單位)
(無詞性變化)
a gallon of milk 一加侖牛奶
miles per gallon 每加侖可行駛的英里數
Dad bought a gallon of milk at the supermarket.
(爸爸在超市買了一加侖的牛奶。)
Gas prices are over four dollars a gallon in the US.
(美國的油價每加侖超過四美元。)

gamble(n./v.)賭博、冒險、打賭
gambler(n.)賭徒
gambling(n.)賭博
gamble away 賭輸(錢財)
take a gamble 冒險一試
He gambled away all his money.
(他把錢全都賭光了。)
Starting a business is always a gamble.
(創業總是一種冒險。)

gang(n./v.)幫派、一夥人、結夥
gangster(n.)歹徒、幫派分子
street gang 街頭幫派
gang up on 聯合起來對付
The police arrested members of the gang.
(警方逮捕了幫派成員。)
It's not fair to gang up on one student.
(聯合起來欺負一個學生是不公平的。)

gap(n.)缺口、差距、間隔
(無詞性變化)
generation gap 代溝
gap year 空檔年
There is a generation gap between my parents and me.
(我和父母之間有代溝。)
Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
(注意列車與月台間的空隙。)

garage(n.)車庫、汽車修理廠
(無詞性變化)
garage sale 車庫拍賣(舊物拍賣)
park in the garage 停在車庫
Dad parked the car in the garage.
(爸爸把車停在車庫裡。)
Our neighbors are having a garage sale this Saturday.
(我們鄰居這星期六要舉辦車庫拍賣。)

gasoline(n.)汽油
gas(n.)汽油(口語)、氣體、瓦斯
gas station 加油站
natural gas 天然氣
We stopped at a gas station to fill up the tank.
(我們在加油站停下來把油加滿。)
The price of gasoline has gone up again.
(汽油價格又上漲了。)

geography(n.)地理、地理學
geographic(adj.)地理的
geographer(n.)地理學家
geography class 地理課
physical geography 自然地理
I learned about mountains and rivers in geography class.
(我在地理課學到山脈和河流的知識。)
The geography of Taiwan is very diverse.
(台灣的地形非常多樣。)

gesture(n./v.)手勢、姿態、表示、做手勢
(無詞性變化)
make a gesture 做手勢
a kind gesture 友善的表示
He made a gesture for me to sit down.
(他做手勢要我坐下。)
Sending flowers was a kind gesture.
(送花是一種貼心的表示。)

glance(n./v.)一瞥、看一眼
(無詞性變化)
at a glance 一眼就
glance at 瞥一眼
She glanced at the clock and hurried out.
(她看了一眼時鐘就匆忙出門。)
I recognized him at a glance.
(我一眼就認出了他。)

global(adj.)全球的、全面的
globe(n.)地球、地球儀
globalization(n.)全球化
global warming 全球暖化
global economy 全球經濟
Global warming is a serious problem for everyone.
(全球暖化對每個人來說都是嚴重的問題。)
English is a global language.
(英文是一種全球通用的語言。)

glory(n.)光榮、榮耀、壯麗
glorious(adj.)光榮的、輝煌的
win glory 贏得榮耀
bring glory to 為…帶來榮耀
The team brought glory to our school.
(這支隊伍為我們學校帶來榮耀。)
The soldiers fought for the glory of their country.
(士兵們為國家的榮耀而戰。)

glow(n./v.)光輝、發光、(臉)發紅
glowing(adj.)熱烈的、發光的
glow in the dark 在黑暗中發光
warm glow 溫暖的光芒
The stars on my ceiling glow in the dark.
(我天花板上的星星會在黑暗中發光。)
Her face glowed with happiness.
(她的臉上洋溢著幸福的光彩。)

golf(n./v.)高爾夫球、打高爾夫球
golfer(n.)高爾夫球員
play golf 打高爾夫球
golf course 高爾夫球場
My uncle plays golf every Sunday.
(我叔叔每個星期天都打高爾夫球。)
The hotel is next to a golf course.
(那間飯店就在高爾夫球場旁邊。)

gossip(n./v.)閒話、八卦、說閒話
(無詞性變化)
gossip about 說…的閒話
office gossip 辦公室八卦
Don't gossip about others behind their backs.
(不要在背後說別人閒話。)
She loves reading celebrity gossip online.
(她很愛在網路上看名人八卦。)

governor(n.)州長、總督、主管
govern(v.)統治、治理
government(n.)政府
state governor 州長
elect a governor 選出州長
The governor of California gave a speech today.
(加州州長今天發表了演說。)
He was elected governor last year.
(他去年當選州長。)

grab(v./n.)抓取、趕緊吃(喝)、攫取
(無詞性變化)
grab a bite 隨便吃點東西
grab someone's attention 吸引某人注意
Let's grab a bite before the movie.
(看電影前我們先隨便吃點東西吧。)
He grabbed my arm to stop me from falling.
(他抓住我的手臂以免我跌倒。)

graduate(n./v.)畢業生、畢業
graduation(n.)畢業、畢業典禮
graduate from 從…畢業
college graduate 大學畢業生
My brother will graduate from high school next June.
(我哥哥明年六月將從高中畢業。)
Many college graduates find it hard to get a job.
(許多大學畢業生很難找到工作。)

grasp(v./n.)抓緊、理解、掌握
(無詞性變化)
grasp the meaning 理解意思
grasp a chance 抓住機會
It took me a while to grasp the main idea of the article.
